## Create Full Products Seamlessly with AntWorks

AntWorks simplifies product development by combining AI and human skills. Our “ant” engineers handle
all stages, from start to finish, making the process quicker, more affordable, and delivering great
results that boost your business.

[dashboard screenshot with dials and graphs.]

## How it works

### Build anything in 4 easy steps.
1. 1
   
   **Chat Interface:**
   Talk to AntWorks just like you're chatting with a real engineer. Just type your ideas or tasks,
   and our platform gets to work.
2. 2
   
   **AntWorks creates a project plan for you:**
   For larger software projects, our AI-powered platform creates a project outline with tasks and
   progress indicators.
3. 3
   
   **Microtasks:**
   AntWorks breaks down projects into small, easy-to-handle tasks called microtasks. Because these
   tasks are so small, they're easy to complete and approve.
4. 4
   
   **Review and Approve:**
   Check the tasks as they're done. If you like what you see, approve them. You only pay for tasks
   you're happy with.

## Pricing

### Choose the plan that works for you

Each microtask costs 1 to 10 credits based on its complexity. A task could be a small app feature, a
website page, or a technical job like a unit test. We think a human engineer needs about 1 hour for
a 10-credit task. You only pay for tasks you like.

### Starter

Pay-as-you-go pricing

$0.99 per credit
[Request Access][5]
* Unlimited projects
* AI-assisted project management
* Basic customer support

* Premium customer support

  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data

# AI Agents for financial crime compliance

Stop wasting time on false positives. Our AI Agents automate AML and sanctions work — increasing
your team’s capacity, cutting costs, ensuring consistency, and mitigating risk with precision. 

[ Request demo ][187]

## Scale capacity. Ensure consistency. Strengthen compliance.

WorkFusion AI Agents act as trained digital analysts, taking on Level 1 alert reviews and Level 2
investigations across sanctions screening alert review, adverse media, enhanced due diligence,
transaction monitoring, and KYC.

Our AI Agents don’t flag alerts like a screening tool; they review and resolve them like an analyst
would. Every decision is documented, explainable, and regulator‑ready. The result: fewer wasted
hours, stronger compliance outcomes, and experts freed to focus on true risk.

**With AI Agents you can:**
* Ensure consistency for alert reviews
* Prevent any potential backlogs
* Scale screening without adding staff
* Reduce outsourcing/contractor costs
* Shift resources to case investigations

## Trusted by 10 of the top 20 banks and leading financial institutions worldwide

## Stop Drowning in Alerts: Make False Positives Irrelevant

#### The Old Approach

Vast amounts of time and money have been devoted to solving false positives. Tuning systems to
reduce low-value alerts was unavoidable.
* Spend heavily on tuning systems
* Outsource L1 work to lower-cost labor
* Replace software at great expense
* Enrich data to prioritize alerts
* Live with alert backlogs

#### The WorkFusion Way

We’re not reducing false positives. Our AI Agents are eliminating them—completely, instantly, and
without wasting more time or money.
* Instantly reviewing every alert
* Applying L1 logic to every decision
* Escalating only the alerts that matter
* Eliminating alert backlogs
* Reviewing alerts in seconds—making volume irrelevant.

# AI Agents for financial crime compliance

Stop wasting time on false positives. Our AI Agents automate AML and sanctions work — increasing
your team’s capacity, cutting costs, ensuring consistency, and mitigating risk with precision. 

[ Request demo ][187]

## Scale capacity. Ensure consistency. Strengthen compliance.

WorkFusion AI Agents act as trained digital analysts, taking on Level 1 alert reviews and Level 2
investigations across sanctions screening alert review, adverse media, enhanced due diligence,
transaction monitoring, and KYC.

Our AI Agents don’t flag alerts like a screening tool; they review and resolve them like an analyst
would. Every decision is documented, explainable, and regulator‑ready. The result: fewer wasted
hours, stronger compliance outcomes, and experts freed to focus on true risk.

**With AI Agents you can:**
* Ensure consistency for alert reviews
* Prevent any potential backlogs
* Scale screening without adding staff
* Reduce outsourcing/contractor costs
* Shift resources to case investigations

## Trusted by 10 of the top 20 banks and leading financial institutions worldwide

## Stop Drowning in Alerts: Make False Positives Irrelevant

#### The Old Approach

Vast amounts of time and money have been devoted to solving false positives. Tuning systems to
reduce low-value alerts was unavoidable.
* Spend heavily on tuning systems
* Outsource L1 work to lower-cost labor
* Replace software at great expense
* Enrich data to prioritize alerts
* Live with alert backlogs

#### The WorkFusion Way

We’re not reducing false positives. Our AI Agents are eliminating them—completely, instantly, and
without wasting more time or money.
* Instantly reviewing every alert
* Applying L1 logic to every decision
* Escalating only the alerts that matter
* Eliminating alert backlogs
* Reviewing alerts in seconds—making volume irrelevant.

# Global Automation Solutions Provider

## Delivering an Automated Advantage for Our Customers 

Brooks is a global leader of automation and contamination control solutions that are a critical
foundation to the AI-enabled world within the semiconductor and life science markets.

## Why Brooks

### Innovation That Enables AI and Powers the Modern World

Semiconductors power the AI revolution. Brooks’ innovation is at the heart of enabling the future of
semiconductors.

Brooks is a strategic partner to leading equipment manufacturers and semiconductor fabs across the
globe. We provide our customers an automated advantage by delivering innovation that exceeds
critical performance and lowers cost of ownership.

Brooks has over 100,000 automation solutions that continually operate around-the-clock within
mission-critical semiconductor and advanced packaging fabs. Brooks’ solutions are foundational in
manufacturing the majority of electronics around the world.

[Why Brooks][28]

## Our Story

### Proven Capabilities That Solve Our Customers’ High-Value Problems

From our beginning in 1978, our founders Norman and Frank Brooks outlined a vision for creating
value in the semiconductor manufacturing industry by applying innovative technology, system
expertise, and close customer partnerships to deliver automated solutions, transforming the
productivity of semiconductor fabrication.

Our team of over 2,000 employees across the globe is at the heart everything we do. We invest in our
customers, employees, communities, partners, and have a solid track record with our investors. These
investments have developed proven capability that is the foundation of providing our customers an
automated advantage.

Our deep knowledge and close collaboration with our customers enables reliable, mission-critical
solutions to their complex, high-value problems.

### Deep Knowledge to Solve Your Complex Challenges

Automation and contamination expertise across mechatronics, material science, thermodynamics,
vision, and surface engineering to solve the most complex engineering challenges.

### Innovation That Lowers Cost of Ownership

We transform knowledge into simulated models that enables us to engineer the best solution for
predictable performance over time.

### Application Clarity That Powers Collaboration

Our experts partner directly with our customers every day to understand and solve high-value
problems they face within their workflow applications.

### Right the First Time, When You Need It

Brooks works with our customers to develop the right solution for your challenges out of the gate,
delivered when you need it.

### Global Operational Excellence From Start to Scale

When our customers are innovating and need tools, we deliver proven solutions to meet their
timeframe. When it’s time to ramp up, we’re ready anywhere across the globe.

### Responsive Lifecycle

# Global Automation Solutions Provider

## Delivering an Automated Advantage for Our Customers 

Brooks is a global leader of automation and contamination control solutions that are a critical
foundation to the AI-enabled world within the semiconductor and life science markets.

## Why Brooks

### Innovation That Enables AI and Powers the Modern World

Semiconductors power the AI revolution. Brooks’ innovation is at the heart of enabling the future of
semiconductors.

Brooks is a strategic partner to leading equipment manufacturers and semiconductor fabs across the
globe. We provide our customers an automated advantage by delivering innovation that exceeds
critical performance and lowers cost of ownership.

Brooks has over 100,000 automation solutions that continually operate around-the-clock within
mission-critical semiconductor and advanced packaging fabs. Brooks’ solutions are foundational in
manufacturing the majority of electronics around the world.

[Why Brooks][28]

## Our Story

### Proven Capabilities That Solve Our Customers’ High-Value Problems

From our beginning in 1978, our founders Norman and Frank Brooks outlined a vision for creating
value in the semiconductor manufacturing industry by applying innovative technology, system
expertise, and close customer partnerships to deliver automated solutions, transforming the
productivity of semiconductor fabrication.

Our team of over 2,000 employees across the globe is at the heart everything we do. We invest in our
customers, employees, communities, partners, and have a solid track record with our investors. These
investments have developed proven capability that is the foundation of providing our customers an
automated advantage.

Our deep knowledge and close collaboration with our customers enables reliable, mission-critical
solutions to their complex, high-value problems.

### Deep Knowledge to Solve Your Complex Challenges

Automation and contamination expertise across mechatronics, material science, thermodynamics,
vision, and surface engineering to solve the most complex engineering challenges.

### Innovation That Lowers Cost of Ownership

We transform knowledge into simulated models that enables us to engineer the best solution for
predictable performance over time.

### Application Clarity That Powers Collaboration

Our experts partner directly with our customers every day to understand and solve high-value
problems they face within their workflow applications.

### Right the First Time, When You Need It

Brooks works with our customers to develop the right solution for your challenges out of the gate,
delivered when you need it.

### Global Operational Excellence From Start to Scale

When our customers are innovating and need tools, we deliver proven solutions to meet their
timeframe. When it’s time to ramp up, we’re ready anywhere across the globe.

### Responsive Lifecycle

## Document and email workflows break in four places. Your operations team feels it.

From intake to decision, the manual document workflow has four failure points. Each one is a tax on
your team and on your customer's experience.

Chasing documents
Extracting data
Cross-checking
Waiting on decisions
DOCUMENT INTAKE

### Your team spends more time chasing documents than processing them.

Inbound docs arrive across email, SFTP, drive folders, vendor portals, and scanned attachments. Half
are missing pages. The latest version is buried in a reply-all thread. Your team becomes the routing
layer copying attachments, classifying intent, asking "did you send the W-2?" for the third time.

Manual extraction

### Your team is reading PDFs and typing the data into systems.

Every invoice, application, claim, and form means someone opens a document, reads the fields, and
types them into NetSuite, Encompass, Epic, or your CRM. Slow. Expensive. Error-prone. The work
scales linearly with volume - your team doesn't.

Case validation

### Every case takes 20 minutes and a human to cross-check.

A loan packet, a claim, a KYC bundle. Each one needs someone to verify names match across three
documents, calculate the DTI, confirm income against the W-2, and check the reserves. The work is
rote, the volume is large, and one mistake costs the team a quarter.

Decision delivery

### Decisions sit in a queue while customers wait.

By the time a document gets routed, extracted, validated, and reviewed, days have passed. Your SLA
slipped. Your customer called twice. Your ops team is firefighting volume instead of improving the
process.

## Multiple Agents. One Operating Layer. Unlimited Document Workflows.

Each Docsumo agent owns one job and does it exceptionally well. Together they form an end-to-end
pipeline from any inbox or document source to your systems of record. Click any agent to see how it
works.

## Document and email workflows break in four places. Your operations team feels it.

From intake to decision, the manual document workflow has four failure points. Each one is a tax on
your team and on your customer's experience.

Chasing documents
Extracting data
Cross-checking
Waiting on decisions
DOCUMENT INTAKE

### Your team spends more time chasing documents than processing them.

Inbound docs arrive across email, SFTP, drive folders, vendor portals, and scanned attachments. Half
are missing pages. The latest version is buried in a reply-all thread. Your team becomes the routing
layer copying attachments, classifying intent, asking "did you send the W-2?" for the third time.

Manual extraction

### Your team is reading PDFs and typing the data into systems.

Every invoice, application, claim, and form means someone opens a document, reads the fields, and
types them into NetSuite, Encompass, Epic, or your CRM. Slow. Expensive. Error-prone. The work
scales linearly with volume - your team doesn't.

Case validation

### Every case takes 20 minutes and a human to cross-check.

A loan packet, a claim, a KYC bundle. Each one needs someone to verify names match across three
documents, calculate the DTI, confirm income against the W-2, and check the reserves. The work is
rote, the volume is large, and one mistake costs the team a quarter.

Decision delivery

### Decisions sit in a queue while customers wait.

By the time a document gets routed, extracted, validated, and reviewed, days have passed. Your SLA
slipped. Your customer called twice. Your ops team is firefighting volume instead of improving the
process.

EBOMI is an inter-denominational, global Christian prayer and outreach movement founded by Prophet
Isa El-Buba, headquartered in Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria. Its mission includes mobilizing,
training, equipping, and empowering believers, leaders, and institutions to live out their prophetic
destinies; advancing the Kingdom of God through intercession, church planting, evangelism, and
community development.

* •Build a strong and militant network of Christians in politics, media, finance, government,

* •Raise an army of intercessors, who pray and intercede for nations, and affect transformation in

## Meet the Prophet

Prophet (Dr) Isa El-Buba is a globally recognized prophetic voice, transformational leader, and
apostolic reformer. He is the visionary behind Evangelical Biblical Outreach Ministries
International (EBOMI), headquartered in Jos, Nigeria—a ministry dedicated to raising "Kingdom
Ambassadors" who shape culture, rebuild nations, and manifest Godly influence in every sphere of
human existence. Known for his uncompromising stance on righteousness and his deep prophetic
insights, Prophet Isa El-buba has spent over four decades pioneering spiritual and social awakening
across the globe. **The Encounter: From Islam to the Cross** Born in Jos into a devout Muslim
family, Prophet Isa’s life took a radical turn in 1982. Following a dramatic, supernatural encounter
with Jesus Christ, he was delivered from deep Islamic occult involvement and commissioned into a
life of Christian ministry. This powerful conversion remains the bedrock of his message: that the
Gospel of Jesus Christ has the power to liberate any soul and transform any nation. **Ministry
Philosophy & Global Impact** Prophet Isa’s ministry is defined by the "Radical Prophetic." His
meetings are marked by the tangible presence of God, healing, and precise prophetic proclamations
that steer the destinies of individuals and governments alike. He carries a specific, divine burden
for: **The Global Mission:** Reaching the Muslim world with the authentic love and truth of Christ.
**Spiritual Awakening:** Equipping the Body of Christ to move beyond religion into supernatural
kingdom assignments. **National Reform:** Acting as a "Watchman" over Nigeria and the nations,
calling leaders to accountability, justice, and godly governance. **A Catalyst for National
Transformation** Beyond the pulpit, Prophet Isa is a fierce advocate for civic responsibility. He is
the convener of the Initiative for a Better and Brighter Nigeria (IBBN). Through this movement, he
mobilizes millions of citizens toward nation-building, credible leadership, and the pursuit of a
righteous political landscape. His influence bridges the gap between the Church and the State,
making him a sought-after voice for national peace and renewal. **Authorship & Global Media** A
prolific communicator, Prophet Isa El-buba reaches millions through his televangelism broadcasts and
published works. His books serve as manuals for spiritual warfare, leadership, and prophetic
activation, ensuring that his mantle of wisdom is accessible to the next generation of believers
worldwide. **Family & Legacy** Prophet Isa El-Buba is happily married to Pastor Choice Isa El-Buba,
a pillar of strength and a co-laborer in the vision. Together, they are blessed with children and
grandchildren who serve alongside them in the ministry. The El-Buba legacy is one of unwavering
commitment to truth, spiritual authenticity, and the relentless pursuit of God’s purpose on earth.

At EBOMI, every heart finds a home, every soul finds love, and every life is changed by the Word of
God.

### We are God's Army marching through the Land.

EBOMI is an inter-denominational, global Christian prayer and outreach movement founded by Prophet
Isa El-Buba, headquartered in Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria. Its mission includes mobilizing,
training, equipping, and empowering believers, leaders, and institutions to live out their prophetic
destinies; advancing the Kingdom of God through intercession, church planting, evangelism, and
community development.

EBOMI aims to:
* •Build a strong and militant network of Christians in politics, media, finance, government,
  military, and the Church.
* •Free believers from religious yokes and reveal Kingdom demands as the key to success and
  advancement.
* •Raise an army of intercessors, who pray and intercede for nations, and affect transformation in
  society, politics, education, culture and more.
* •Promote Unity beyond denominational boundaries.

## Meet the Prophet

Prophet (Dr) Isa El-Buba is a globally recognized prophetic voice, transformational leader, and
apostolic reformer. He is the visionary behind Evangelical Biblical Outreach Ministries
International (EBOMI), headquartered in Jos, Nigeria—a ministry dedicated to raising "Kingdom
Ambassadors" who shape culture, rebuild nations, and manifest Godly influence in every sphere of
human existence. Known for his uncompromising stance on righteousness and his deep prophetic
insights, Prophet Isa El-buba has spent over four decades pioneering spiritual and social awakening
across the globe. **The Encounter: From Islam to the Cross** Born in Jos into a devout Muslim
family, Prophet Isa’s life took a radical turn in 1982. Following a dramatic, supernatural encounter
with Jesus Christ, he was delivered from deep Islamic occult involvement and commissioned into a
life of Christian ministry. This powerful conversion remains the bedrock of his message: that the
Gospel of Jesus Christ has the power to liberate any soul and transform any nation. **Ministry
Philosophy & Global Impact** Prophet Isa’s ministry is defined by the "Radical Prophetic." His
meetings are marked by the tangible presence of God, healing, and precise prophetic proclamations
that steer the destinies of individuals and governments alike. He carries a specific, divine burden
for: **The Global Mission:** Reaching the Muslim world with the authentic love and truth of Christ.
**Spiritual Awakening:** Equipping the Body of Christ to move beyond religion into supernatural
kingdom assignments. **National Reform:** Acting as a "Watchman" over Nigeria and the nations,
calling leaders to accountability, justice, and godly governance. **A Catalyst for National
Transformation** Beyond the pulpit, Prophet Isa is a fierce advocate for civic responsibility. He is
the convener of the Initiative for a Better and Brighter Nigeria (IBBN). Through this movement, he
mobilizes millions of citizens toward nation-building, credible leadership, and the pursuit of a
righteous political landscape. His influence bridges the gap between the Church and the State,
making him a sought-after voice for national peace and renewal. **Authorship & Global Media** A
prolific communicator, Prophet Isa El-buba reaches millions through his televangelism broadcasts and
published works. His books serve as manuals for spiritual warfare, leadership, and prophetic
activation, ensuring that his mantle of wisdom is accessible to the next generation of believers
worldwide. **Family & Legacy** Prophet Isa El-Buba is happily married to Pastor Choice Isa El-Buba,
a pillar of strength and a co-laborer in the vision. Together, they are blessed with children and
grandchildren who serve alongside them in the ministry. The El-Buba legacy is one of unwavering
commitment to truth, spiritual authenticity, and the relentless pursuit of God’s purpose on earth.

## Effortless document processing with ECIT Digital.

Send any document through Email, API, E-Invoice, or as paper to one of our scanning locations.

Multiple machine learning models captures and classifies data from your document.

Our team validates the output from the capture process and correct mistakes eliminating need for

Modernize your invoicing with ECIT Digital’s secure, fully digital solutions. We ensure compliance

## Integration as a service

At ECIT Digital, we make integration easy and reliable. Our Integration as a Service handles the
full lifecycle — from monitoring and error handling to format validation — ensuring secure,
compliant, and seamless data flow. We take full responsibility for connecting systems and managing
standards, so you can focus on your core business. With us, integration is a trusted service, not
just a project.

[Learn more about integrations][64]

Bridge traditional documents and digital workflows with ECIT Digital’s PDF to Electronic Document
service. We convert PDFs like invoices and orders into structured formats such as PEPPOL BIS, EHF,
and XML for seamless system integration. Our intelligent engine ensures accurate data extraction,
validation, and enrichment, even from non-digital partners. With ERP integration and customizable
output, we align critical information like product codes and customer references—helping you
eliminate manual work, reduce errors, and speed up digital transformation.

How it works

## Effortless document processing with ECIT Digital.

1. Import

Send any document through Email, API, E-Invoice, or as paper to one of our scanning locations.

2. Capture

Multiple machine learning models captures and classifies data from your document.

3. Validate

Our team validates the output from the capture process and correct mistakes eliminating need for
controlling data for you as customer.

4. Export

The system can export data to any API, SFTP, Email or similar in the format required by the
receiving system. Exports can be configured based on the content of documents, and ECIT Digital
supports integration to multiple systems in one document flow.

## Integration as a service

At ECIT Digital, we make integration easy and reliable. Our Integration as a Service handles the
full lifecycle — from monitoring and error handling to format validation — ensuring secure,
compliant, and seamless data flow. We take full responsibility for connecting systems and managing
standards, so you can focus on your core business. With us, integration is a trusted service, not
just a project.

## PDF to Electronic Document

Bridge traditional documents and digital workflows with ECIT Digital’s PDF to Electronic Document
service. We convert PDFs like invoices and orders into structured formats such as PEPPOL BIS, EHF,

validation, and enrichment, even from non-digital partners. With ERP integration and customizable
output, we align critical information like product codes and customer references—helping you
eliminate manual work, reduce errors, and speed up digital transformation.

# Big events come with big opportunities

Scale premium offerings with differentiated connectivity
[Discover how the game is changing][211]

## Highlights

[[""]][212]
Jul 14, 2026 | Press release

#### [Ericsson releases its Q2 2026 financial report][213]

Ericsson’s Q2 results underscore the strength of its portfolio and disciplined execution, with a
48.4% adjusted gross margin and a strong net cash position. Read the full report.

[[""]][214]
Jun 30, 2026 | Topic

#### [Your guide to differentiated connectivity][215]

Explore the Differentiated Connectivity Handbook – a practical guide to design, launch, and scale
profitable 5G services.

[[""]][216]
May 18, 2026

#### [Ericsson ranked #2 among Europe's top innovators][217]

Fortune's 2026 Most Innovative Companies list places Ericsson second among Europe's leading
companies driving the future of technology.

[[Ericsson Mobility Report June 2026 front cover. ]][218]

#### [Unpack the Mobility Report][219]

Webinar: hear what the latest data signals for service providers and enterprises - straight from the
team behind it.

[[""]][220]
Jun 11, 2026 | Magazine

#### [Four ways to grow your network without growing energy costs][221]

New analysis from Ericsson Research sets out four imperatives for improving energy efficiency at
scale – even with a 3.5x growth in traffic. Get the insights now.

[[""]][222]
May 11, 2026 | Blog post

#### [AI agents solving real network problems][223]

Multi-vendor agentic AI is transforming Cloud RAN troubleshooting. See how it cuts through complex
handoffs to find root causes across the full stack.

The next wave of mobile will transform businesses, unlock network value, and drive innovation.

[Explore our vision][224]

[Explore public sector solutions][228]

Innovative solutions and services customized to support your digital transformation journey.

We drive business value by combining deep technology expertise with industry-leading platforms to
solve the document-centric content challenges of even your most complicated digital transformation
projects.

## Core Operation Automation

Digitization and automation of your core operations yields ROI through increased efficiency,
improved customer satisfaction, engaged employees - and more collaboration and sales.

#### Financial Process Automation

Transform your economic engine with automation of key functions like invoice processing, accounts
receivable, vendor management, and sales order processing.

#### Communications

Manage brand and access to key assets and deliver content to staff, customers, and business partners
across multiple channels, including email, web, SMS and printed documents.

#### Digital Mailroom

Automate the labor-intensive tasks associated with processing the inflow of information and
unstructured data from sources like mail, fax, online forms, and email attachments.

#### Information Governance

Gain knowledge to understand better, measure, and manage your electronic information for
determination of what information to trust, keep, secure, connect, and discard.

#### Onboarding

Accelerate customer acquisition and engagement, reduce costs, mitigate risks, and fulfill
industry-specific employment requirements like licensure verification.

# Automation solutions since 1954


Güdel is a globally operating industrial company based in Switzerland. As one of the world's leading
providers of solutions for industrial automation, Güdel offers its customers everything from a
single source: from high-precision machine components to intelligent automation solutions.

The technology of Güdel is characterised by its innovation, modularity and quality. Güdel has around
1000 employees in over 20 locations around the world.
 

[Learn more][75]

## RACK & PINION FINDER

### Find the perfect rack or pinion for your application

The Rack & Pinion Finder helps you find the ideal rack and pinion for your application – from basic
to high-end. Our product lines provide perfectly coordinated options that integrate seamlessly into
your systems. For specific needs, our semi-finished products offers a fast and cost-effective
solution.

[Rack & Pinion Finder][76]

## GANTRY FINDER

### Find the perfect gantry for your application

The Gantry Finder helps you identify the ideal gantry solution for your specific requirements.
Simply define the number of axes, payload, and axis reach to discover the right solution from our
modular, high-performance portfolio.

[Gantry Finder][77]

## SOLUTIONS

### Add value to your entire manufacturing process using smart Güdel automation solutions.

AutomotiveBuilding materialsMachine toolsRailwayEnergyComposite
manufacturingIntralogisticsAerospaceFoodTire

 

[Learn more about our solutions][78]

In our download center you will find extensive documentation on our products, brochures, data
sheets, CAD data, certificates and much more.

# Automation solutions since 1954


Güdel is a globally operating industrial company based in Switzerland. As one of the world's leading
providers of solutions for industrial automation, Güdel offers its customers everything from a
single source: from high-precision machine components to intelligent automation solutions.

The technology of Güdel is characterised by its innovation, modularity and quality. Güdel has around
1000 employees in over 20 locations around the world.

more.

## What is it used for?

HARPA automates your copywriting, email management, web search, online data extraction and web
monitoring tasks.

It is used to quickly write and reply to emails, post comments and DMs, summarise and “talk to” web
pages, YouTube videos, PDF documents, extract and research SEO keywords, create SMM content plans
and Midjourney prompts, automate form filling, write blog articles, review CVs, job offers and legal
documents, plan trips, track competitors, prices and SERP pages, create learning plans, search for
information and more.

## What makes HARPA different?

HARPA can read, understand and act upon web page content.

It can navigate, click and extract data from web pages, run it through Large Language Models, paste
back to websites or trigger IFTTT chains such as Zapier and Integromat.

Ultimate copilot and AI Agent for your web browsing, search and automation tasks. It provides access
to AI on any website, and you can use HARPA with almost every web service or online app.

HARPA has a basic free tier and a demo period for it's premium features. You can try the app before
making an informed purchase.

Basic **S** plan starts with **$12 per month** paid annually, includes CloudGPT connection, cloud
command storage, chat history [and more][33].

can also limit the number of automations that are run simultaneously in the HARPA app settings.

HARPA stands for High Availability Robotic Process Automation. HARPA is designed to bridge the gap
between AI and Automation and serve as your virtual assistant and a digital workforce for your
business.

  password, and complete the sign-up process.

Choose the appropriate option and create the account. ChatGPT will send a verification email to the
registered email address.

Step 2: Open your email account and verify your email address by clicking the Verify Email Address
button and enter your full name.

Step 3: Enter your phone number. ChatGPT will send a verification code to your phone number. Verify
it by typing the code in the space provided. Finally, your ChatGPT account is ready to use!

### Upload and download files

Securely upload files for automation, extract structured data, and download results in bulk.

### Integrate with your existing tools

Build automations for any browser application. Integrate directly with 2,500+ apps and services.

### Automate authentication

Automatically solve captchas, complete 2FA, and securely manage logins.

### Complete complex forms

Complete complex dynamic forms directly from unstructured data.

## Built for Security
## Certified for Compliance.

HIPAA compliant and enterprise-grade encryption ensure your data stays protected.

[HIPAA compliance badge]

### HIPAA Compliant

### Enterprise-Grade Encryption

[Soc2]

### SOC 2 Certified

[No training on data - prohibition symbol]

### No Training on Data

## Frequently Asked Questions

All your automation questions, answered.

### How long does it take to build a Kaizen workflow?

Customers typically have their first workflow up and running in less than an hour.

### How reliable are Kaizen workflows?

Kaizen workflows operate deterministically, ensuring that your process is executed the exact same
way, every single time.

### How can I trigger Kaizen workflows from my application?

Kaizen supports robust APIs and webhooks for creating logins, executing workflows, retrieving
execution results, and triaging work for human review.

### How does Kaizen handle 2FA for end-user logins?

We support 2FA in a number of ways:

• Email: Kaizen allows you to email 2FA codes to codes@mfa.kaizenautomation.com to automatically
complete logins for sites that require 2FA.
• TOTP (Authenticator app): Kaizen has a built-in authenticator, so you can upload a QR code or a
secret key to the Kaizen platform and Kaizen will automatically generate 2FA codes.
• SMS: We can handle SMS-based 2FA via API integration or through a Twilio integration.

### Where do Kaizen workflows run?

After creating a Kaizen workflow, it runs on secure browsers in the cloud. This allows you to
infinitely scale your automations based on your desired volume.

### Do you cache individual browser actions?

All actions completed are cached as speed and reliability are core priorities for our customers.

### What is your pricing model?

Kaizen's pricing is simple, we charge on credits consumed each time a workflow is run.

# **Your AI initiative is only as good as the data feeding it.**

**Power your Gen-AI retrieval and results with clean structured data effortlessly transformed. **

What we hear enterprise leaders saying

### "We bought the AI platform. Now what?"

The tools are in place but the data inputs are a mess. Clean data was always the assumption, never
the plan.

### "We've talked to five vendors. Everyone sounds the same."

AI. Automation. Intelligent. Every company promises transformation. Almost none can show you the
path.

### "Our documents are everywhere and in every format."

PDFs, scanned images, emails, handwritten forms — siloed across systems no one wants to touch.

Most enterprises aren’t failing at AI because of the wrong model. 

They’re failing because the information that should be powering those models is** buried in
documents, emails, and forms — unstructured, uncleaned, and unusable.**

## We Fix That!

# **Your AI initiative is only as good as the data feeding it.**

**Power your Gen-AI retrieval and results with clean structured data effortlessly transformed. **

What we hear enterprise leaders saying

### "We bought the AI platform. Now what?"

The tools are in place but the data inputs are a mess. Clean data was always the assumption, never
the plan.

### "We've talked to five vendors. Everyone sounds the same."

AI. Automation. Intelligent. Every company promises transformation. Almost none can show you the
path.

### "Our documents are everywhere and in every format."

PDFs, scanned images, emails, handwritten forms — siloed across systems no one wants to touch.

Most enterprises aren’t failing at AI because of the wrong model. 

They’re failing because the information that should be powering those models is** buried in
documents, emails, and forms — unstructured, uncleaned, and unusable.**

## We Fix That!

## Real results.

Outcomes from organizations like yours.

## 1.67M

###### documents processed in 6 months for state agency

## 100%

###### ROI in a matter of months for an automotive parts distributor

## 60%

###### improvement in capture accuracy at aviation maintenance center

## 1000

###### invoices per day at textile manufacturer

## Don't just take our word for it...

"We knew that we needed to find a solution that would speed up our processes, make us more
efficient, and enable us to provide better service to our end users. Now we don’t spend any time
manually searching for invoices and there are no misfilings. KeyMark is wonderful to work with."
AP DirectorAnMed Medical Center
“Moving to KeyMark's capture solution greatly improved the accuracy of document keywords being
lifted from our scans. It also allowed us to reduce the amount of time our company spends
integrating data documents and correcting keyword errors."
Support SpecialistWest Star Aviation
"We need 2.5 fewer FTEs focused on capturing documents, so we can save more headcount for serving
our clients."
Business Systems ManagerBremerton Housing Authority

How we work

## From buried information to activated AI in four steps.

We don’t ask you to rip out what you have. **We meet you where you are** and build a path forward
that proves itself early and scales deliberately.

### 1
### Find the Data

Map every source of unstructured content — documents, emails, images, forms — regardless of format
or system.

### 2
### Make it Usable

Extract, classify, and structure content into clean, normalized data your systems can actually
consume.

### 3
### Govern it Properly

Apply the controls, audit trails, and retention policies that enterprise compliance actually
requires.

### 4
### Activate Your AI

Feed your models, workflows, and decision engines with data that’s clean, contextual, and ready.

## Not sure where your AI initiative stands? Let's find out together.

We offer a working session designed for one purpose: to give you an honest, clear picture of your
organization's AI data readiness and a practical first step forward.

**What we will provide you:**
* A map of where your unstructured data lives and why it’s blocking AI progress
* Clarity on the two or three highest-ROI use cases for your organization
* An honest assessment of what’s realistic in 90 days vs. 12 months
* A shared language your technical and executive teams can align around

Kovil AI offers free rematching with no questions asked. You only pay if you decide to hire after

Our engineers build AI agents, LLM-powered chatbots, RAG pipelines, workflow automations, and custom

Every engineer is paired with an Engagement Manager who audits every commit. Projects are

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Kovil AI?

Kovil AI is a managed AI engineering firm that embeds vetted Tier-1 AI engineers into your team. We
offer fixed-price AI project delivery, scalable team augmentation, and AI app rescue — all
milestone-gated with zero delivery risk.

### How quickly can Kovil AI match me with an AI engineer?

Most matches are made within 24–48 hours. Your engineer can start within a week, and your first
feature typically ships within 14 days of kick-off.

### What if the AI engineer isn't the right fit?

Kovil AI offers free rematching with no questions asked. You only pay if you decide to hire after
the two-week trial period — zero commitment, zero termination fees.

### What types of AI projects does Kovil AI build?

Our engineers build AI agents, LLM-powered chatbots, RAG pipelines, workflow automations, and custom
AI integrations across fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, logistics, and more.

### How does Kovil AI ensure delivery quality?

Every engineer is paired with an Engagement Manager who audits every commit. Projects are
milestone-gated — you approve each phase before the next begins, ensuring zero delivery surprises.

## The operating system for smarter MSPs

MSPbots automates your entire operation, connects your whole tool stack, and gives you the
intelligence to make better decisions faster.

#### AI ticket triage

From 3 minutes to 3 seconds. Every ticket. Stop starting every morning with manual categorization.
MSPbots reads, classifies, and routes every incoming ticket instantly. It is trained on MSP-specific
language and works inside your existing PSA from day one.
‍

[Learn more][28]

#### AI ticket QA

AI Ticket QA automatically reviews every ticket against MSP industry best practices, helping you
measure service quality at scale. It identifies strengths, uncovers improvement opportunities, and
shows where your team stands on the path to operational maturity.

[Learn more][29]

#### NextTicket dispatch

The right ticket to the right tech. Automatically. End ticket cherry-picking and queue politics for
good. MSPbots routes every ticket based on skill, priority, and SLA. This ensures your dispatcher
focuses on judgment calls rather than day-to-day queue management.

[Learn more][30]

#### Sentiment analysis

Consistent service quality. Without the manual review. Catch issues before clients do. MSPbots
reviews ticket handling, flags gaps in resolution quality, and sends coaching nudges automatically —
so your standards stay high across every tech, every shift.

[Learn more][31]

#### Business intelligence

See it. Act on it. Automatically. One real-time dashboard pulling KPIs from 80+ integrations — SLA
tracking, technician utilization, ticket aging, and more. And when the numbers go off track,
automated bots fire instantly.
‍

[Learn more][32]

Up and running fast. Results even faster.

[[interface] screenshot of data analytics dashboard (for an ai saas company)]

Define exactly how tickets should be triaged, dispatched, or reviewed. Set your ticket types,
statuses, and triage rules, then show the AI examples of spam. The system handles the rest.
[[interface] screenshot of data analytics dashboard (for an ai saas company)]

##### Connect your PSA

Instantly link your PSA, RMM, and communication tools to streamline your workflow. With over 80
native integrations, zero development work is required.
[[interface] screenshot of data analytics dashboard (for an ai saas company)]

##### Let the AI work

Tickets are automatically read, classified, routed, and reviewed. The more it runs, the smarter it
gets with every feedback loop.
[[interface] screenshot of data analytics dashboard (for an ai saas company)]

##### See everything in Real-Time

As the AI works, your dashboards come alive — ticket flow, technician performance, SLA health, and
queue status, all updating live.

Synchronisation of data in accounting systems

IT Services company | Accounting & Finance

Solution

An RPA algorithm was used for synchronisation between the databases, which is faster than standard
cycles and is adaptive. RPA wins in cost & implementation speed compared to the standard "hard code"
automation method.

Result

The synchronisation process between systems is sped up, which reduces the pause time of processes.
Employees are engaged in more value-added tasks and are more motivated.

[ Read full case ][127]

Linking payroll card expenses to applications

HR department | Accounting & Finance

Solution

Using a robot to process corporate card payments in SAP ERP: the robot enters document transactions
& enriches the payment documents with data and moves on to the next transaction to link the
applications to the payments.

Result

The process is accelerated by a factor of 2, human is excluded from the process & operations are
carried out in a timely and error-free manner.

[ Read full case ][128]

Label printing

Knitwear manufacturing company | Production

Solution

Developing and configuring an algorithm for a robot to retrieve data for printing from various
sources.

Result

The robot has reduced the barcode printing speed by a factor of four, from 8 hours to 2 hours. The
company has improved employee productivity and eliminated possible errors due to human error.

[ Read full case ][129]

Reconciliation of shipment documentation

Pharmaceutics | Logistics and Warehouse Operations

Solution

The robot uses optical recognition to automatically digitize documents and check them for
discrepancies, then notifies employees. The AI, in combination with automation, runs an ML program
to check customer conversations for potential compliance risks.

Result

95% manual work reduction, 24/7 process and data flow.

[ Read full case ][130]

Accrual of bonuses/penalties to suppliers

Large retail chain | Purchasing Department

Solution

PIX RPA technology made it possible to configure the robot basedon a large number of different
conditions and branches of the algorithm, covering the full range of different potential agreements
and bonus accrual conditions and fines.

Result

Processing reduced from 15 minutes to 2 minutes.

[ Read full case ][131]

Automation of processes at an airport

Large International Airport | Business Operations

Solution

Robots conducted an analysis of required fuel loads, which vary depending on flight conditions.
Robots performed a breakdown history analysis for improved maintenance. Processes in HR, accounting
andfinance were automated.

Result

65000 working hours, spared by the end of the first year.

Synchronisation of data in accounting systems

IT Services company | Accounting & Finance

Solution

An RPA algorithm was used for synchronisation between the databases, which is faster than standard
cycles and is adaptive. RPA wins in cost & implementation speed compared to the standard "hard code"
automation method.

Result

The synchronisation process between systems is sped up, which reduces the pause time of processes.
Employees are engaged in more value-added tasks and are more motivated.

[ Read full case ][127]

Linking payroll card expenses to applications

HR department | Accounting & Finance

Solution

Using a robot to process corporate card payments in SAP ERP: the robot enters document transactions
& enriches the payment documents with data and moves on to the next transaction to link the
applications to the payments.

Result

The process is accelerated by a factor of 2, human is excluded from the process & operations are
carried out in a timely and error-free manner.

[ Read full case ][128]

Label printing

Knitwear manufacturing company | Production

Solution

Developing and configuring an algorithm for a robot to retrieve data for printing from various
sources.

Result

The robot has reduced the barcode printing speed by a factor of four, from 8 hours to 2 hours. The
company has improved employee productivity and eliminated possible errors due to human error.

[ Read full case ][129]

Reconciliation of shipment documentation

Pharmaceutics | Logistics and Warehouse Operations

Solution

The robot uses optical recognition to automatically digitize documents and check them for
discrepancies, then notifies employees. The AI, in combination with automation, runs an ML program
to check customer conversations for potential compliance risks.

Result

95% manual work reduction, 24/7 process and data flow.

[ Read full case ][130]

Accrual of bonuses/penalties to suppliers

Large retail chain | Purchasing Department

Solution

PIX RPA technology made it possible to configure the robot basedon a large number of different
conditions and branches of the algorithm, covering the full range of different potential agreements
and bonus accrual conditions and fines.

Result

Processing reduced from 15 minutes to 2 minutes.

[ Read full case ][131]

Automation of processes at an airport

Large International Airport | Business Operations

Solution

Robots conducted an analysis of required fuel loads, which vary depending on flight conditions.
Robots performed a breakdown history analysis for improved maintenance. Processes in HR, accounting
andfinance were automated.

Result

65000 working hours, spared by the end of the first year.

# Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about our services, features, and more. Whether you're a new user
or a long-time customer, this page is designed to help you get the most out of ProValet. If you
don't find the answer you're looking for, feel free to contact our support team for further
assistance.

[See All FAQs][51]
What is ProValet?

ProValet is the all-in-one automation platform for recurring, route-based service companies —
including pool, lawn, and home watch. It replaces scattered tools with one system that manages
scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, payments, and customer communication automatically.

Who is ProValet built for?

We serve companies that deliver recurring services — pool and spa care, lawn and landscape, and home
watch. Whether you run one route or many, ProValet gives you control, visibility, and automation to
scale profitably.

What makes ProValet different from Skimmer, PoolBrain, or ServiceTitan?

ProValet is **purpose-built for recurring service operations**, not one-off jobs.

Unlike competitors, it automates every stage — scheduling, field reporting, invoicing, and customer
updates — while maintaining a simple, operator-friendly interface and open integrations.

How fast can my business go live with ProValet?

Most companies launch within **days, not weeks**. We handle data import, setup, and technician
onboarding with personalized support from our U.S.-based team.

Can you migrate me from Skimmer or another platform?

Yes — our onboarding specialists provide guided migration from Skimmer, ServiceTitan, spreadsheets,
or any legacy system. You’ll go live quickly with all your data intact.

How does ProValet handle invoicing and payments?

ProValet Active Invoicing™ automates billing from start to finish. Jobs convert into invoices
instantly, and customers can pay via card or ACH — with your custom convenience fees applied
automatically.

[
See all ProValet Features
][52]
Does ProValet integrate with QuickBooks and payment processors?

Yes — ProValet offers **true two-way QuickBooks Online sync**, keeping invoices, payments, and
customers perfectly aligned. Integrated payments let you get paid faster without manual
reconciliation.

What's included for my customers?

Your customers get a free **Homeowner App** that delivers visit reports, photos, messages, and
instant payment options — an Uber-like experience that builds trust and retention.

How secure and reliable is ProValet?

ProValet is hosted on AWS with bank-grade encryption, daily backups, and 99.9% uptime. Role-based
access and strict data controls ensure your business — and your customers — stay protected.

How much does ProValet cost?

Pricing is transparent and scales with your number of active customers — no long-term contracts or
hidden fees. See detailed plans at [provalet.io/pricing][53].

Try ProValet, the game-changer for route based service companies.

# Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about our services, features, and more. Whether you're a new user
or a long-time customer, this page is designed to help you get the most out of ProValet. If you
don't find the answer you're looking for, feel free to contact our support team for further

[See All FAQs][51]
What is ProValet?

ProValet is the all-in-one automation platform for recurring, route-based service companies —
including pool, lawn, and home watch. It replaces scattered tools with one system that manages
scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, payments, and customer communication automatically.

Who is ProValet built for?

We serve companies that deliver recurring services — pool and spa care, lawn and landscape, and home
watch. Whether you run one route or many, ProValet gives you control, visibility, and automation to
scale profitably.

What makes ProValet different from Skimmer, PoolBrain, or ServiceTitan?

ProValet is **purpose-built for recurring service operations**, not one-off jobs.

Unlike competitors, it automates every stage — scheduling, field reporting, invoicing, and customer
updates — while maintaining a simple, operator-friendly interface and open integrations.

How fast can my business go live with ProValet?

Most companies launch within **days, not weeks**. We handle data import, setup, and technician
onboarding with personalized support from our U.S.-based team.

Can you migrate me from Skimmer or another platform?

Yes — our onboarding specialists provide guided migration from Skimmer, ServiceTitan, spreadsheets,
or any legacy system. You’ll go live quickly with all your data intact.

How does ProValet handle invoicing and payments?

ProValet Active Invoicing™ automates billing from start to finish. Jobs convert into invoices
instantly, and customers can pay via card or ACH — with your custom convenience fees applied
automatically.

[
See all ProValet Features

Does ProValet integrate with QuickBooks and payment processors?

Yes — ProValet offers **true two-way QuickBooks Online sync**, keeping invoices, payments, and
customers perfectly aligned. Integrated payments let you get paid faster without manual
reconciliation.

What's included for my customers?

Your customers get a free **Homeowner App** that delivers visit reports, photos, messages, and
instant payment options — an Uber-like experience that builds trust and retention.

How secure and reliable is ProValet?

ProValet is hosted on AWS with bank-grade encryption, daily backups, and 99.9% uptime. Role-based
access and strict data controls ensure your business — and your customers — stay protected.

How much does ProValet cost?

Pricing is transparent and scales with your number of active customers — no long-term contracts or
hidden fees. See detailed plans at [provalet.io/pricing][53].

## Aggregation

[Radium AI Integration]

**Radium AI** collects bot-run details from multiple RPA instances and brings them to its central
repository for classification. It integrates with all the leading RPA platforms like UiPath,
Automation Anywhere (AA), and Blue Prism (BP). Data collected from various data sources enables
Radium AI to provide powerful analytics about bot operations.

Integrates with ITSM systems like ServiceNow to auto-generate tickets for all failures, minimizing
the need for 24×7 eyes on the glass.

## Classification

Powerful **ML Engine** analyzes the bot errors, identifies the root cause, and answers the two
fundamental questions of incident management:
* Who should be resolving this problem?
* What should be the action taken?

Real-time assignment of the appropriate resolver group and recommended action drastically reduces
the *turnaround time* and effort that goes into digital worker support.

[Radium AI Classification]
[Automated Issue Resolution]

## Automated Issue Resolution

Accurate detections & precise classifications lead to optimal automated solutions. **Radium AI** not
only recommends resolutions to the errors but also has an in-built action library that takes
corrective actions.

Our robust **workflow engine** allows you to define *‘custom auto actions’* that can be activated
against bot failures.

# Stop doing the work that slows you down

Grow your MSP by increasing team capacity and automating the busywork that slows you down.

[Book a demo][48] [Explore the Rewst platform][49]
[opening]

## Automation built for the way MSPs do business

When manual processes slip, techs spin their wheels, budgets bleed on unused licenses, and clients
lose patience.

Rewst flips the equation. Built for the way MSPs operate, it combines native multi-tenancy, a
library of integrations and ready-to-use automations that we maintain for you, and RoboRewsty, an
in-platform AI assistant that guides you every step of the way.

The result: less busywork, faster ROI, more accurate workflows, and room to grow by increasing team
capacity. Employees get more breathing room to focus on higher-value work, which leads to faster
response times, fewer errors, and better service for clients.

## What MSPs are saying about Rewst

[Check out success stories][50]

“Rewst is helping us to quickly automate all the processes we never had time to do ourselves. New
user onboarding, security alerts, and managing products save a ton of support time and eliminate
human error. All while avoiding having to write and maintain complex scripts.”

— Dustin Bolander, CIO & Partner, Clear Guidance Partners

“Even though we already have an RMM tool, there is no other solution like Rewst that will automate
so many mundane tasks that are currently manual. With prebuilt automations connecting tools like
HubSpot and our PSA, we see Rewst as a game changer for our business.”

— Karl Bickmore, CEO, Snap Tech IT

“At this point, we’re averaging 75-80 hours of time savings per week with Rewst. That’s 300+ hours
saved per month, allowing us to focus on the tickets that need human intervention rather than wading
through the endless noise from automated alerts.”

— Dustin Lepi, Automation Engineer, Network IT Easy

“What drew me to Rewst was the fact that they were agnostic about what they needed me to be
connected to. You didn’t have to be on a specific platform or RMM.”

— Matt Rose, CXO, Tech Rage IT

[Automated new user onboarding]

Let staff and clients trigger multi-step flows without extra hand-holding.
[Form-triggered workflow automation]

### Documentation automation

Automatically capture notes, sync them to your PSA, and keep client records consistent and up to
date.
[Automated documentation generation]

### Security alerts

Filter noise, surface the real issues fast, and automatically remediate common threats.
[Real-time security monitoring alerts]

### Billing reconciliation

Find unused seats and free budget before it leaks.
[Automated billing reconciliation]

### Offboarding

Revoke access, reclaim licenses, and notify stakeholders in one pass.
[Employee offboarding automation]

## Meet RoboRewsty

#### Build or edit your own automations, just by asking

Describe what you want to automate in plain language and RoboRewsty, Rewst's in-platform AI
assistant, builds the workflow for you, including the tasks, triggers, transitions, and forms. Start
with a prebuilt automation, and make it your own, or build a new one from scratch. Just tell
RoboRewsty what to do. See how it works in 60 seconds.

# Stop doing the work that slows you down

Grow your MSP by increasing team capacity and automating the busywork that slows you down.

[Book a demo][48] [Explore the Rewst platform][49]
[opening]

## Automation built for the way MSPs do business

When manual processes slip, techs spin their wheels, budgets bleed on unused licenses, and clients
lose patience.

Rewst flips the equation. Built for the way MSPs operate, it combines native multi-tenancy, a
library of integrations and ready-to-use automations that we maintain for you, and RoboRewsty, an
in-platform AI assistant that guides you every step of the way.

The result: less busywork, faster ROI, more accurate workflows, and room to grow by increasing team
capacity. Employees get more breathing room to focus on higher-value work, which leads to faster
response times, fewer errors, and better service for clients.

## What MSPs are saying about Rewst

[Check out success stories][50]

“Rewst is helping us to quickly automate all the processes we never had time to do ourselves. New
user onboarding, security alerts, and managing products save a ton of support time and eliminate
human error. All while avoiding having to write and maintain complex scripts.”

— Dustin Bolander, CIO & Partner, Clear Guidance Partners

“Even though we already have an RMM tool, there is no other solution like Rewst that will automate
so many mundane tasks that are currently manual. With prebuilt automations connecting tools like
HubSpot and our PSA, we see Rewst as a game changer for our business.”

— Karl Bickmore, CEO, Snap Tech IT

“At this point, we’re averaging 75-80 hours of time savings per week with Rewst. That’s 300+ hours
saved per month, allowing us to focus on the tickets that need human intervention rather than wading
through the endless noise from automated alerts.”

— Dustin Lepi, Automation Engineer, Network IT Easy

“What drew me to Rewst was the fact that they were agnostic about what they needed me to be
connected to. You didn’t have to be on a specific platform or RMM.”

— Matt Rose, CXO, Tech Rage IT

Start by identifying your nagging and repetitive processes. Then, use popular prebuilt automations,

## How can you reduce your busywork?

Start by identifying your nagging and repetitive processes. Then, use popular prebuilt automations,
 customize them, or build your own automations as your needs and skills grow.

### New user setup & onboarding

Provision accounts, licenses, and access in minutes.
[Automated new user onboarding]

### Form-triggered workflows

Let staff and clients trigger multi-step flows without extra hand-holding.
[Form-triggered workflow automation]

### Documentation automation

Automatically capture notes, sync them to your PSA, and keep client records consistent and up to
date.
[Automated documentation generation]

### Security alerts

Filter noise, surface the real issues fast, and automatically remediate common threats.
[Real-time security monitoring alerts]

### Billing reconciliation

Find unused seats and free budget before it leaks.
[Automated billing reconciliation]

### Offboarding

Revoke access, reclaim licenses, and notify stakeholders in one pass.
[Employee offboarding automation]
[Browse prebuilt automations][51]

## Meet RoboRewsty

#### Build or edit your own automations, just by asking

Describe what you want to automate in plain language and RoboRewsty, Rewst's in-platform AI
assistant, builds the workflow for you, including the tasks, triggers, transitions, and forms. Start
with a prebuilt automation, and make it your own, or build a new one from scratch. Just tell
RoboRewsty what to do. See how it works in 60 seconds.

[Learn more about RoboRewsty][52]

Bring your most painful or repetitive processes, snag your technical and business leaders, and see

[Pre-built automation deployment]

### Launch ready-made automations

Start with Crates (our prebuilt automations) and begin saving time and streamlining operations
quickly.
[Automation scaling and expansion]

### Scale the way you want

Expand from prebuilt automations to flexible builds that fit your business model and skills.
[Custom workflow development]

### Get support and continually level up

Get continual, comprehensive support from our expert teams, the active Community, and Cluck
University training.

## Connections you don’t have to babysit

## Kofax Power PDF Support — Download Help & FAQs

### Power PDF Frequently Asked Questions

I Have a Nuance Power PDF License
What is the relationship between Nuance and Kofax?
Kofax acquired the Document Imaging division from Nuance in 2019, which includes Power PDF,
PaperPort, OmniPage and several other products and services. Kofax has since rebranded to Tungsten
Automation. Read more here.
Does Kofax support Nuance Power PDF customers?
For existing customers of Nuance Power PDF, PaperPort and OmniPage desktop products with a valid
serial number, the technical support team does provide support, depending on which version of
software you own. Learn more about what is supported here.
Can I redownload my Nuance Power PDF file?
Tech support does not maintain old product files, so if you own any Nuance version of software and
you didn\'t back it up or have the original CD, then you will need to upgrade to the latest Kofax
version. As an existing Nuance Power PDF customer, you are eligible for a discount. Please contact
support or engage with a chat rep on any of the Power PDF pages with your serial number to get your
discount code.
How do I upgrade from Nuance Power PDF to Kofax Power PDF 5?
If you own any older version of Power PDF or PDF Converter (including Nuance Power PDF 2 or 3), you
are eligible for an upgrade discount. Please contact tech support or engage with a chat rep on any
of the Power PDF pages to get your discount code. You can also download a free trial of the latest
version to test compatibility.
I Have a Kofax Power PDF License
How can I download my Kofax Power PDF file?
After your purchase is complete, you\'ll be provided a link to download your Power PDF software from
2Checkout.com. This link is valid for two weeks only after purchase, unless you purchased download
insurance which extends downloads to 24 months. Please download immediately and back it up in case
you need to reinstall in the future. Because this is a perpetual license of the version available on
the day you purchase, Kofax will not provide any download links after the two week period, as the
software may have been updated and changed.
I\'m having trouble with the installation. What do I do?
When downloading and installing your trial, please make sure to turn off any anti-virus software.
Some strict programs will block download or incorrectly flag the Power PDF .exe file as a virus.
You\'ll also want to make sure you have enough storage on your computer.
Do I get updates and upgrades with my purchase?
Power PDF, PaperPort and OmniPage desktop products are perpetual licenses. This means you own the
specific version of software you bought on your date of purchase. With these retail, individual
licenses, there are no upgrades or updates included with the purchase. To get a future upgrade, you
will need to purchase the software again. Existing customers are eligible for upgrade discounts.
Contact customer support or engage with a chat rep to get your code.
How many machines can I install my Power PDF license on?
Power PDF Standard, Standard for Mac and Advanced are single licenses meant to be installed on your
primary machine. Our EULA permits installation on a second machine for backup use. However, you can
only use it on one machine at a time. If you get a new computer, please remember to uninstall so you
can free up an activation. You may also contact customer support to assist with deactivating your
old machine.
Power PDF Free Trial Download
How do I download a free trial of Kofax Power PDF?
Signup for a free 15-day trial by selecting the product you\'d like to try:
Power PDF Advanced for Windows
Power PDF Standard for Windows
Power PDF Standard for Mac
How long does the free trial last?
Your free trial lasts 15 days, after which you\'ll need to purchase a license to continue using the
software.
Is the trial software the same as the full license?
Yes, all functionality and features are available to trial users. The only limitation is the 15-day
duration.
Is Kofax Power PDF a subscription?
Power PDF is a perpetual license, which means once you buy a license, you own it forever. If you
purchase an individual license, there are no additional monthly or annual fees. This is why many
users download Power PDF as an alternative to Adobe Acrobat\'s subscription model. For Enterprise
volume licenses, you have the option for an annual maintenance package which includes all updates

## Kofax Power PDF Support — Download Help & FAQs

### Power PDF Frequently Asked Questions

I Have a Nuance Power PDF License
What is the relationship between Nuance and Kofax?
Kofax acquired the Document Imaging division from Nuance in 2019, which includes Power PDF,
PaperPort, OmniPage and several other products and services. Kofax has since rebranded to Tungsten
Automation. Read more here.
Does Kofax support Nuance Power PDF customers?
For existing customers of Nuance Power PDF, PaperPort and OmniPage desktop products with a valid
serial number, the technical support team does provide support, depending on which version of
software you own. Learn more about what is supported here.
Can I redownload my Nuance Power PDF file?
Tech support does not maintain old product files, so if you own any Nuance version of software and
you didn\'t back it up or have the original CD, then you will need to upgrade to the latest Kofax
version. As an existing Nuance Power PDF customer, you are eligible for a discount. Please contact
support or engage with a chat rep on any of the Power PDF pages with your serial number to get your
discount code.
How do I upgrade from Nuance Power PDF to Kofax Power PDF 5?
If you own any older version of Power PDF or PDF Converter (including Nuance Power PDF 2 or 3), you
are eligible for an upgrade discount. Please contact tech support or engage with a chat rep on any
of the Power PDF pages to get your discount code. You can also download a free trial of the latest
version to test compatibility.
I Have a Kofax Power PDF License
How can I download my Kofax Power PDF file?
After your purchase is complete, you\'ll be provided a link to download your Power PDF software from
2Checkout.com. This link is valid for two weeks only after purchase, unless you purchased download
insurance which extends downloads to 24 months. Please download immediately and back it up in case
you need to reinstall in the future. Because this is a perpetual license of the version available on
the day you purchase, Kofax will not provide any download links after the two week period, as the
software may have been updated and changed.
I\'m having trouble with the installation. What do I do?
When downloading and installing your trial, please make sure to turn off any anti-virus software.
Some strict programs will block download or incorrectly flag the Power PDF .exe file as a virus.
You\'ll also want to make sure you have enough storage on your computer.
Do I get updates and upgrades with my purchase?
Power PDF, PaperPort and OmniPage desktop products are perpetual licenses. This means you own the
specific version of software you bought on your date of purchase. With these retail, individual
licenses, there are no upgrades or updates included with the purchase. To get a future upgrade, you
will need to purchase the software again. Existing customers are eligible for upgrade discounts.
Contact customer support or engage with a chat rep to get your code.
How many machines can I install my Power PDF license on?
Power PDF Standard, Standard for Mac and Advanced are single licenses meant to be installed on your
primary machine. Our EULA permits installation on a second machine for backup use. However, you can
only use it on one machine at a time. If you get a new computer, please remember to uninstall so you
can free up an activation. You may also contact customer support to assist with deactivating your
old machine.

How do I download a free trial of Kofax Power PDF?
Signup for a free 15-day trial by selecting the product you\'d like to try:

Power PDF Standard for Mac
How long does the free trial last?
Your free trial lasts 15 days, after which you\'ll need to purchase a license to continue using the
software.
Is the trial software the same as the full license?
Yes, all functionality and features are available to trial users. The only limitation is the 15-day
duration.
Is Kofax Power PDF a subscription?
Power PDF is a perpetual license, which means once you buy a license, you own it forever. If you
purchase an individual license, there are no additional monthly or annual fees. This is why many
users download Power PDF as an alternative to Adobe Acrobat\'s subscription model. For Enterprise
volume licenses, you have the option for an annual maintenance package which includes all updates
and upgrades, as well as extended tech support.

### NOUS CONNAÎTRE

Depuis près de 35 ans, UNA Rhône Métropole de Lyon s’est employée à soutenir ses adhérents dans
leurs difficultés quotidiennes, à innover dans le domaine de la qualité, de l’évaluation des besoins
des personnes, de la formation professionnelle…

[En savoir plus...][164]
[Figure 28 - acceuil picto 5]

### LE RÉSEAU UNA

UNA, 1er réseau français de l’Aide, des Soins et des Services aux domiciles est une** **Fédération à
but non lucratif créé en 1970 et reconnue d’utilité publique en 1996. UNA regroupe plus de 800
structures issues de l’économie sociale et solidaire ou…

[En savoir plus...][165]
[Picto Syndicat employeur]

### SYNDICAT EMPLOYEUR

En tant que syndicat employeur, UNA a un rôle d’acteur majeur du dialogue social au sein de notre
branche. À ce titre, UNA représente ses adhérents sur le champ du dialogue social de la Branche de
l’aide, de l’accompagnement, des soins et des services à domicile …

[En savoir plus...][166]

à nous contacter.
Notre équipe se fera un plaisir de vous répondre dans les meilleurs délais.
